item.title: Monaco allocates 156 state-owned homes in latest housing commission
item.description: The allocations bring the total number of state-owned homes attributed to Monegasque households to more than 1,300 since the National Housing Plan was launched in 2019.

item.title: Leclerc leads Ferrari’s charge at season opener as Russell wins in Melbourne
item.description: Leclerc led from fourth on the grid at the Australian Grand Prix before finishing third in what Fred Vasseur called the most exciting F1 race in a decade.

item.title: Monaco completes evacuation of nationals stranded in Middle East conflict
item.description: The final group of Monégasque nationals stranded in the Middle East arrived home on Sunday, completing an emergency repatriation operation that began when the United States and Israel launched a major military offensive against Iran.

item.title: New PowHer interactive format proves to be a hit as Monaco marks International Women’s Day
item.description: For its eighth edition, the Powher event went fully interactive, guiding paricipants through a series of workshops to find clues and come out more aware of the inequalities women face in sport and health.

item.title: Why did the Prince’s Palace light up in blue?
item.description: Throughout the world, the day was marked with moments of silence, lowering of flags, laying of wreaths, and reading names of fallen officers.

item.title: Two commercial spaces available to let at Fontvieille Shopping Centre
item.description: The Prince's Government is inviting applications to lease two commercial spaces at the Fontvieille Shopping Centre, as a renovation and restructuring project for the site remains under consideration.

item.title: “Real life Princess Diaries”: Jazmin Grimaldi opens up about her story while announcing debut album
item.description: In a social media video posted last week to mark her 34th birthday, Jazmin talks about her story in detail, introducing it as the "real life Princess Diaries".

item.title: €299 a month to find a date: Inside Monaco’s most ambitious start up pitch night
item.description: Seven startups pitched to investors at Monaco’s K2 March Investor Lounge, showcasing ideas from AI finance tools to a €299-a-month dating app — with several bold concepts catching the room’s attention.

item.title: European Commission sets out gender equality strategy through to 2030
item.description: One of the strategy's most prominent concerns is cyberviolence, which is disproportionately affecting women and girls, with measures to combat sexually explicit deepfakes and so-called deepnudes.

item.title: Giangiacomo Serena di Lapigio claims record fourth Primo Cup title
item.description: Giangiacomo Serena di Lapigio has won the Primo Cup-UBS Trophy for the third consecutive year, taking his overall tally to four victories and setting a new record for the event.
